blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Researchers in industry and academia use synthetic survey respondents powered by large language models as substitutes for human samples. These synthetic populations require validation against real-world data, so researchers often address them using ad hoc comparisons with human surveys. Inspired by the intention–behaviour gap in behavioural science, we argue that these validations test the wrong thing for most applied cases where decision makers commission synthetic research to anticipate consequential behaviour. To address this problem, we propose a validation framework with two requirements. First, every validity claim must state its level of correspondence with human data: does the sample predict what the represented people do, which of four diagnostics (location, dispersion, response process and structure) does the validation address, and does the validation compare against experimental effects? Second, researchers must report validity claims for subgroups, since these groups are often the most affected by consequential decisions and aggregate accuracy hides their misrepresentation. Our validation framework operationalises three justice dimensions (distributional, procedural, and recognition) as measurable quantities and defines within-persona counterfactual experiments as a validation requirement. We then apply the framework to electric vehicle charging tariffs, before closing with a reporting checklist that researchers can use to make convincing validity claims.
blocks.zh: 工业界和学术界的研究人员使用大型语言模型驱动的合成调查答卷人作为人类样本的替代品。 这些合成种群需要对照现实世界的数据进行验证,因此研究人员经常使用与人类调查的临时比较来解决. 受行为科学的意向 — — 行为差距的启发,我们提出,这些验证对大多数应用案例来说是错的,因为决策者委托合成研究来预测相应的行为。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一个有两个要求的验证框架。 首先,每个有效性主张都必须说明它与人类数据对应的程度:样本是否预测了被代表的人做什么,验证地址是哪一种诊断(位置,分散,反应过程和结构),验证与实验效果进行比较? 第二,研究人员必须报告对分组的有效性主张,因为这些分组往往受到相应决定的影响最大,而总体准确性掩盖了它们的错报。 我们的验证框架将三个司法层面(分配、程序和承认)作为可计量的数量加以运作,并将人内反事实实验定义为验证要求。 然后,我们将框架适用于电动车辆收费,然后用一份报告清单结束,研究人员可以利用该清单提出令人信服的有效性主张。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Several companies now offer access to populations of synthetic survey respondents built on large language models (LLMs). Researchers in the social sciences have started using these respondents as pilot samples, substitutes for hard-to-recruit participants, and a way to test experimental designs before fielding ( Anthis et al., 2025 ; Bail, 2024 ; Grossmann et al., 2023 ) . This technique, often called silicon sampling, addresses several bottlenecks of traditional research. In particular, it can reduce months of fieldwork to a few days, though population-scale simulation still consumes substantial compute and energy ( Sarstedt et al., 2024 ; {International Energy Agency}, 2025 ) . Synthetic respondents are also both easy to relate to and easy to access. They can be interviewed whenever the researcher pleases, and they adopt a familiar format for practitioners: the persona.
blocks.zh: 有几个公司现在向基于大语言模型的合成调查答卷人提供访问机会。 社会科学的研究人员已开始使用这些受访者作为试点样本,代之以难以征聘的参与者,以及实地作业前测试实验设计的方法(Anthis等人,2025年;Bail,2024年;Grossmann等人,2023年)。 这种技术常被称为硅取样,解决了传统研究的几个瓶颈. 特别是,它可以将几个月的实地工作减少到几天,尽管人口规模模拟仍然消耗大量的计算和能量(Sarstedt等人,2024年;{国际能源机构},2025年)。 合成答复者既容易联系,也容易接触。 他们可以随时接受研究人员的采访,他们为从业者采用了一种熟悉的格式:人物.

blocks.en: The persona has been a working tool in user research for decades ( Cooper, 1999b ; Pruitt and Grudin, 2003 ) , and synthetic versions slot neatly into the same workflows (Section 1.1 ). However, unlike statistical models that serve similar predictive purposes in marketing and political campaigns ( Kosinski et al., 2013 ; Matz et al., 2017 ; Nickerson and Rogers, 2014 ) , these personas’ ease of use makes erroneous answers hard to spot and accuracy hard to affirm. Synthetic personas can also be duplicated and put into different experimental conditions in ways that are metaphysically impossible for humans (viz. the fundamental problem of causal inference; Holland, 1986 ). For instance, synthetic personas can run as parallel, uncontaminated counterfactuals of themselves, opening a route to estimating treatment-effect heterogeneity at the individual level rather than at the subgroup level. However, no convention currently exists to evaluate these capabilities.
blocks.zh: 该人物几十年来一直是用户研究的一个工作工具(Cooper,1999b;Pruitt和Grudin,2003年),以及合成版本的插槽完美地进入同一工作流程(第1.1节)。 然而,与市场营销和政治竞选中服务于类似预测目的的统计模型不同(Kosinski等人,2013年;Matz等人,2017年;Nickerson和Rogers,2014年),这些人物的易用性使得错误答案难以发现,准确性也难以确认. 合成人也可以复制,以人类在物理上不可能的方式投入不同的实验条件(viz. 因果关系推论的根本问题;Holland, 1986.). 例如,合成人本身可以作为平行的、未受污染的反事实运行,为估计个人层面而不是分组层面的治疗-效应异质性开辟了一条途径。 然而,目前还没有评估这些能力的公约。

blocks.en: In a typical synthetic study, validation usually involves prompting a model with a demographic description and comparing its outputs on attitude or opinion items against a human sample. These validation tests focus on aggregate per-item marginal distributions and thus find strong correspondence between models and humans ( Argyle et al., 2023 ; Bisbee et al., 2024 ; Santurkar et al., 2023 ) . Yet, after establishing this correspondence, subsequent validations do little to assess whether synthetic samples can predict human behaviour and avoid behavioural science’s infamous intention-behaviour gap ( Sheeran and Webb, 2016 ; Ajzen, 1991 ) .
blocks.zh: 在典型的合成研究中,验证通常涉及激发带有人口描述的模型,并将其在姿态或意见项上的输出与人类样本进行比较. 这些验证测试侧重于每个项目的聚合边际分布,从而发现模型与人类之间的强烈对应(Argyle等人,2023年;Bisbee等人,2024年;Santurkar等人,2023年)。 然而,在建立此函证之后,后续的验证对于评估合成样本能否预测人类行为并避免行为科学的臭名昭著的意向-行为差距(Sheeran and Webb, 2016; Ajzen, 1991)几乎没有作用.

blocks.en: This oversight is problematic, since decisions like accepting a job, buying a heat pump or agreeing to medical treatment all have costs for the individuals who do them, whereas answering a survey item does not. Likewise, stated-preference methods overstate willingness to pay relative to revealed choices ( Murphy et al., 2005 ) , and self-reports of pro-environmental behaviour correlate only moderately with individuals’ actual behaviour ( Kormos and Gifford, 2014 ) . Thus, agreement with human survey responses cannot establish whether a synthetic sample accurately predicts the consequential behaviour that practitioners most often want to anticipate, nor can it suggest whether the sample preserves the relationship between intention and behaviour in human samples.
blocks.zh: 这种监督是有问题的,因为接受工作、购买热泵或同意医疗等决定都由做这些工作的个人承担费用,而回答调查项目则不承担费用。 同样,所宣称的偏好方法比公开的选择(Murphy等人,2005年)和亲环境行为的自我报告略微与个人的实际行为相关(Kormos和Gifford,2014年)。 因此,与人类调查答复的一致无法确定合成样本是否准确预测从业人员最经常希望预期的间接行为,也无法表明样本是否保留了人类样本中意图与行为之间的关系。

blocks.en: We use this critique to make three contributions to the nascent field of synthetic research. First, we set out the behavioural criterion and diagnostic levels that researchers must use to make validity claims about human data. Second, inspired by research on algorithmic fairness, we treat subgroup specification as a validity requirement rather than a separate ethical consideration ( Buolamwini and Gebru, 2018 ; Obermeyer et al., 2019 ) . In doing so, we propose an operationalisation of the distributional, procedural, and recognition dimensions of justice, focusing on subgroup error, documentation, and preserved variance. Finally, we describe within-persona counterfactual experiments, the evaluation design they imply, and what validation against this criterion requires. Our final evaluation framework is purposefully agnostic to synthetic respondent construction, whether via prompting, demographic profiles, or interview data. We conclude that all synthetic research requires documentation of a persona-construction procedure, along with an explicit statement of the research’s target validity level and its subgroup claims.
blocks.zh: 我们利用这种批评,为新生的合成研究领域做出了三个贡献。 首先,我们规定了研究人员必须使用的行为标准和诊断水平,以便对人类数据提出有效性主张。 第二,在算法公平研究的启发下,我们将分组规格视为有效性要求,而不是单独的伦理考虑(Buolamwini and Gebru, 2018; Obermeyer et al., 2019). 为此,我们建议落实司法的分布、程序和承认层面,重点是分组错误、文件记录和保留差异。 最后,我们描述人内反事实实验,它们所暗示的评价设计,以及对照这个标准进行验证需要什么. 我们的最后评价框架有意地对合成应答结构不可知,无论是通过提示、人口概况还是访谈数据。 我们的结论是,所有合成研究都要求记录人造程序,同时明确说明研究的目标有效性水平及其分组说法。

blocks.en: 1 What to validate
blocks.zh: 页:1 要验证什么

blocks.en: 1.1 Personas and degrees of specificity
blocks.zh: 1.1 个人和具体程度

blocks.en: The term ‘persona’ is used differently across fields. In the machine learning literature, the term usually refers to the text that a model is conditioned upon, which can range from a single demographic attribute to the transcript of a two-hour interview ( Hu and Collier, 2024 ; Park et al., 2026 ) . At its most basic, a model is prompted without any individual information; here, its outputs rely predominantly on its training data and lean toward the views of younger, better-educated, and more liberal respondents ( Motoki et al., 2024 ; Santurkar et al., 2023 ) . To counter this, most silicon sampling studies provide models with demographic profile information using in-context learning and, on occasion, supervised fine-tuning ( Argyle et al., 2023 ; Bisbee et al., 2024 ; Santurkar et al., 2023 ) . At the upper end of specificity, models can be fed extensive material about individual persons, including interview transcripts with those persons, demonstrating improved accuracy in representing those individuals ( Park et al., 2026 ) . Nonetheless, an open question remains: does higher specificity necessarily improve behavioural prediction? Our framework enables researchers to test this question.
blocks.zh: “人”一词在不同领域使用不同。 在机器学习文献中,这个术语通常是指模型所附带条件的文字,从一个单一的人口属性到两个小时的采访记录(Hu and Collier, 2024; Park et al., 2026). 在最基本的情况下,一个模型是没有任何个人资料的;在这方面,其产出主要依赖其培训数据,并倾向于更年轻、受教育程度更高和更自由的答复者的观点(Motoki等人,2024年;Santurkar等人,2023年)。 为了解决这一问题,大多数硅取样研究都利用内文学习和有时监督微调为模型提供人口概况信息(Argyle等人,2023年;Bisbee等人,2024年;Santurkar等人,2023年)。 在具体化的上端,可以向模型提供关于个人的广泛材料,包括与这些人的面谈记录,表明代表这些人的准确性有所提高(Park等人,2026年)。 然而,还有一个未决问题:更高的具体性是否必然改善行为预测? 我们的框架使研究人员能够测试这个问题。

blocks.en: Here, we caveat that specificity has a legal limit. A persona constructed to represent a named living person, assembled from material about that person, can raise data protection and profiling issues under the General Data Protection Regulation and the EU AI Act. Accordingly, for this paper, we restrict the definition of a persona to one particular synthetic respondent that represents a hypothetical archetype (as named in Cooper, 1999a ), in the sense of a stylised individual with the characteristics of its profile (that is, the specification text supplied to the model). All other claims in this paper concern sets of personas, compared with the human population whose characteristics they share and reported per stratum.
blocks.zh: 在此,我们告诫说,具体性是有法律限制的。 为代表一个有名的活人而从有关该人的材料中组装的人,可以根据《一般数据保护条例》和《欧盟AI法》提出数据保护和剖析问题。 因此,就本文件而言,我们将人的定义a 限于代表假设型(如Cooper,1999年a.所述)的某个特定合成应答者,即具有其特征(即提供给模型的规格文本)的形而上学的个人。 本文提出的所有其他索赔都涉及几组人,而人口的特点则与各阶层人口相同。

blocks.en: 1.2 Behaviour as the target of prediction
blocks.zh: 1.2 作为预测目标的行为

blocks.en: In our framework, the target of interest is a consequential behaviour observed in a defined population under defined conditions. This behaviour may involve adopting an innovation, choosing a medical procedure, switching tariffs, or completing a financial transaction. We concede that self-reports remain valid targets when the research question concerns experience or opinion itself (e.g., well-being or public support). However, what people say and what they do are different measurable quantities (the intention–behaviour gap), meaning a synthetic sample can match one without matching the other. Beliefs, preferences, and perceived constraints are latent states that shape both what a person says and what they do, yet cost, opportunity, and social desirability affect the two differently, and the gap widens when behaviour is costly ( Ajzen and Fishbein, 1977 ; Kormos and Gifford, 2014 ; Murphy et al., 2005 ) . Therefore, if models tighten the coupling between self-reports, we should not expect them to preserve the looser human coupling between report and action. At best, these models would behave as if people did what they said.
blocks.zh: 在我们的框架内,利益目标是在规定的条件下在界定的人口所观察到的一种间接行为。 这种行为可能涉及采用创新、选择医疗程序、转换关税或完成金融交易。 我们承认,当研究问题涉及经验或意见本身(如福祉或公众支持)时,自我报告仍然是有效的目标。 然而,人们所说的话和所做的事是不同的可测量数量(意图-行为差距),意味着合成样本可以匹配一个而不能匹配另一个。 信仰、偏好和感知的制约是潜在的状态,既决定一个人所说的话,又决定他们的行为,然而成本、机会和社会可取性对两者的影响不同,当行为代价高昂时差距就会扩大(Ajzen and Fishbein,1977年;Kormos and Gifford,2014年;Murphy等人,2005年)。 因此,如果模型加强自我报告之间的结合,我们不应指望它们保持报告与行动之间的松散的人类结合。 这些模型充其量会表现得像人们所说的话一样.

blocks.en: This argument implies that synthetic research validation must predict what people do rather than what people say (Figure 1 ), a contrarian position relative to current norms in the field. For example, early studies compared model output to survey items ( Argyle et al., 2023 ; Santurkar et al., 2023 ) , and critiques of these works then examined response biases, option ordering, and prompt sensitivity in simulated questionnaires ( Dominguez-Olmedo et al., 2024 ; Tjuatja et al., 2024 ) . Subsequently, some studies tried to move beyond self-report by examining responses to laboratory tasks and economic games ( Aher et al., 2022 ; Binz et al., 2025 ; Horton et al., 2023 ) , a route with its own lab-to-field gap (see Section 2.1 ).
blocks.zh: 这一论点意味着,合成研究验证必须预测人们做什么,而不是人们所说的话(图1),相对于该领域目前的规范而言,这是一种相反的立场。 例如,早期研究将模型输出与调查项目进行比较(Argyle等人,2023年;Santurkar等人,2023年),对这些作品的批评随后审查了反应偏差、选择顺序和模拟问卷中的迅速敏感性(Dominguez-Olmedo等人,2024年;Tjuatja等人,2024年)。 随后,一些研究试图通过审查对实验室任务和经济游戏的反应来超越自我报告(Aher等人,2022年;Binz等人,2025年;Horton等人,2023年),这条路线有其自身的实验室对实地差距(见第2.1节)。

blocks.en: Compounding the issue is a marked decline of directly observed behavioural studies in the field’s flagship journals ( Baumeister et al., 2007 ) , with some counts putting the share of studies measuring actual behaviour at 6 to 18% ( Doliński, 2018 ) . Because direct observational experiments are expensive, and cheaper online self-report surveys are attractive, pressure to push behaviour out of the discipline now risks besetting synthetic validation, as researchers continue to pursue verbal correspondence instead of reproducing behavioural outcomes. Therefore, to meet the academics, policymakers, and boards who commission synthetic research and care about behavioural outcomes, the field must course-correct and explicitly state whether validations target verbal or behavioural correspondence. We call this difference between a persona’s stated dispositions and the observed conduct of the represented people the persona intention–behaviour gap , and the comparison of this quantity with the human coupling for the same population and behaviour the synthetic intention–behaviour gap (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 令问题更加复杂的是,实地旗舰杂志(Baumeister等人,2007年)直接观测到的行为研究明显下降,有些研究将衡量实际行为的研究比例定为6-18%(Doliński,2018年))。 由于直接观测实验费用昂贵,更便宜的在线自报调查具有吸引力,迫使行为退出学科的压力现在有可能困扰合成验证,因为研究人员继续追求口头通信而不是复制行为结果. 因此,为了会见委托对行为结果进行合成研究和关注的学者、决策者和董事会,实地必须正确和明确地说明验证是针对口头还是行为通信。 我们把人所宣称的处置方式和所观察到的被代表人民的行为之间的这种区别称为个人意图 — — 行为差距,并将这一数量与同一人群的人类结合和行为相提并论 — — 行为差距(图1)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Two kinds of correspondence and three kinds of gaps. Verbal correspondence is how synthetic samples are validated today; behavioural correspondence, operationalised as the persona intention–behaviour gap, is the criterion (C) this paper argues for; the synthetic intention–behaviour gap benchmarks the two.
blocks.zh: 图1:两种函证和三种差距. 口头通信是合成样本在今天是如何验证的;行为通信,作为个人意图-行为差距运作,是本文所主张的标准(C);合成意图-行为差距基准两者。

blocks.en: 2 Levels of correspondence between synthetic and human responses
blocks.zh: 2 合成反应和人类反应之间的对应程度

blocks.en: Assessing whether we should be convinced by a synthetic study’s validation depends on whether the study is exploratory, substantive (i.e., used in a comparison between conditions or groups), or predictive. This argument follows measurement theory’s standard view, where scholars consider validity as a property of a measurement’s interpretation and use rather than of the instrument itself ( Cronbach and Meehl, 1955 ; Messick, 1995 ; Borsboom et al., 2004 ) . Jacobs and Wallach ( 2021 ) apply the same reasoning to fairness in machine learning, describing how algorithms can cause harm when they operationalise a latent construct, such as risk, creditworthiness, or fairness, in ways that diverge from their intended meaning. Since the representativeness of a synthetic sample is a latent construct, what it means to match a human population must therefore differ by application. We implement this logic below through a set of levels, each licensing a different validity claim.
blocks.zh: 评估综合研究是否应该说服我们,取决于研究是探索性的、实质性的(即用于比较各种条件或群体)还是预测性的。 这一论点遵循了计量理论的标准观点,学者认为有效性是计量的解释和使用而不是仪器本身的属性(Cronbach and Meehl,1955年;Messick,1995年;Borsboom等人,2004年)。 Jacobs and Wallach(2021年)在机器学习中将同样的推理应用于公平性,描述了算法在操作潜在构造,如风险,信用性,或公平性时,如何以偏离其本意的方式造成伤害. 由于合成样品的代表性是一种潜在的构造,因此,与人类人口匹配的含义必须因应用的不同而有所不同。 我们下面通过一套级别执行这个逻辑,每个级别都许可不同的有效性主张.

blocks.en: In Table 1 , we define a behavioural criterion (C) that reflects whether the personas in a synthetic study predict the observed behaviour of the group they purport to represent. We separate this criterion from four diagnostic levels (L0 to L3), designed to locate representation failures in a synthetic study. Each level uses a human reference band to describe the expected variation for the same quantity across comparable human samples or repeated measurements. Accordingly, validation should report uncertainty in the synthetic-human comparison and specify an acceptable discrepancy before inspecting correspondence. Beyond these levels, we use a cross-cutting comparison (E) that focuses on the effects of experimental manipulations and assesses whether a simulation is appropriate for allocating resources across groups.
blocks.zh: 在表1中,我们界定了一个行为标准(C),反映合成研究中的人是否预测他们声称代表的群体观察到的行为。 我们把这个标准从四个诊断级(L0到L3)分离出来,目的是在合成研究中找出表达故障. 每一级都使用人类参照波段来描述可比较的人类样本或重复测量中同一数量的预期变化。 因此,审定应报告合成人与人类比较中的不确定性,并在检查通信之前具体说明可接受的差异。 在这些水平之外,我们使用一个交叉比较(E),侧重于实验操纵的影响,并评估模拟是否适合在各组之间分配资源。

blocks.zh: 表1:合成和人类反应之间的对应程度

blocks.en: 2.1 The criterion: Behaviour
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 标准:行为

blocks.en: Our behavioural criterion focuses on what people did, recorded in the field where possible. This behavioural evidence comes in three forms: expressive behaviour in the wild (posting, sharing, commenting), physical or economic behaviour (enrolment, purchase, uptake), and high-stakes decisions (incentivised choices, binding recommendations). These measures record actions with consequences for the person or others and, as such, circumvent the low cost of stating an intention in a survey response.
blocks.zh: 我们的行为标准侧重于人们做了什么,尽可能记录在外地。 这种行为证据有三种形式:野外的表达行为(张贴、分享、评论)、身体或经济行为(入学、购买、接受)和高决定(鼓励选择、具有约束力的建议)。 这些措施记录了对个人或他人造成后果的行动,并因此避免了在调查答复中说明意图的低费用。

blocks.en: To use this evidence, researchers should evaluate behavioural predictions using held-out outcomes unavailable during persona construction, prompt selection, and model tuning. While doing so, their tests should conform to the following rules: (1) baselines must be declared: evaluators should compare personas against demographic base rates and against an unconditioned model, not against chance. (2) calibration must hold within stratum and not only on average, for the reasons outlined in Section 3 . (3) where self-report is also available, evaluators should compare the personas’ intention–behaviour gap to the human intention–behaviour gap observed for the same population and behaviour (Section 1.2 ). Notably, a set of personas for which the two gaps diverge may predict behaviour correctly and still mistranslate interventions that work through intention, such as those captured in message tests or policy pre-tests. Thus, if all three tests hold, the evaluator can claim that the synthetic sample predicts what the stratum of represented people will do, for the given behaviour, population, and model.
blocks.zh: 为了利用这些证据,研究人员应利用在人造、迅速选择和模型调整期间无法获得的搁置结果来评价行为预测。 在这样做时,他们的测试应符合下列规则:(1) 基准必须申报:评估人员应将人与人口基准率和无条件模式进行比较,而不是偶然。 (2) 校准必须在层次内进行,而不只是平均进行,原因见第3节概述。 (3) 在也有自我报告的情况下,评估人员应将个人意图 -- -- 行为差距与人类意图 -- -- 对同一人口和行为观察到的行为差距进行比较(第1.2节)。 值得注意的是,由于两个差距不同,一组人可能预测行为正确,而且仍然错误地翻译出通过意图发挥作用的干预措施,如在信息测试或政策前测试中所捕获的干预措施。 因此,如果这三项测试都有效,评估人员可以声称,合成样品预测了代表人物的阶层会为特定行为、人口和模型做些什么。

blocks.en: 2.2 Diagnostic levels
blocks.zh: 2.2 诊断水平

blocks.en: Moving from our behavioural criterion to diagnostics, level 0 assesses whether a synthetic sample lands where a human population does on the quantity of interest. At this level, evaluators should compare the synthetic sample against a population statistic such as a mean or proportion, with the relevant quantity being the difference between synthetic and human estimates relative to the human estimate’s sampling error. Previous studies show that models successfully copy, for example, the marginal distributions of American National Election Studies items when conditioned on demographic backstories ( Argyle et al., 2023 ) and reach aggregate agreement on public-opinion batteries ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , though performance drops where there are fewer training data for a topic or a population (e.g., non-WEIRD contexts; Henrich et al., 2010 ). For an absolute location error, smaller values indicate closer correspondence, although the synthetic mean can depart from the human mean in either direction. Evaluators’ strongest claim at this level is that the synthetic sample approximates a population aggregate on this item, for this population, with this model and prompt. They cannot infer anything more about variation, associations, or the effects of interventions.
blocks.zh: 从我们的行为标准转向诊断,第0级评估合成样本是否在人类对兴趣量的支配下着陆。 在这个级别上,评价人员应当将合成样品与人口统计(如平均或比例)进行比较,有关数量是合成和人类估计与人类估计取样误差的差别。 以往的研究表明,模型成功地复制了美国国家选举研究项目在以人口背景为条件时的边际分布(Argyle等人,2023年),并就公共-opinion电池达成总体协议(Sun等人,2024年),虽然在某一主题或人口的培训数据较少的地方(例如非WEIRD背景;Henrich等人,2010年),性能下降。 对于绝对位置错误,较小的值表示更接近对应,尽管合成的平均值可以在任意方向偏离人类平均值. 评估者最强烈的主张是,合成样品以这种模型和迅速性接近这一类人口的总数。 他们再也不能推论变化、关联或干预的效果。

blocks.en: Level 1 compares the synthetic sample against the spread of the human response distribution (i.e., its variance and a distributional distance), since a sample can have the right average but still misrepresent its population. So far, this is where models fail most consistently. Namely, they compress variance and produce too few responses in the tails, such that a synthetic distribution matches the human mean while remaining too narrow ( Bisbee et al., 2024 ) . We call this behaviour distribution collapse or flattening, where a synthetic sample reduces a group’s diversity to a single representative position. Evaluators’ strongest claims here hold for response spread and minority-position size, subject to the subgroup conditions of Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 1级将合成样本与人类反应分布的分布(即其差异和分布距离)进行比较,因为样本可以有正确的平均值,但仍会歪曲其种群. 迄今为止,这是模型最经常失败的地方。 也就是说,它们在尾部压缩差异,产生的反应太少,因此合成的分布与人类的平均值相符,同时保持过窄(Bisbee等人,2024年)。 我们称之为行为分布崩溃或平缓,其中合成样本将一个群体的多样性降低到单一的代表性位置。 评估者最强烈的主张是反应扩大和少数职位的规模,但须符合第3节的分组条件。

blocks.en: Since human survey responses shift with question wording, item order, and response format, at level 2, we test whether the synthetic sample reacts to context and format as people do, using human test-retest bands and documented context effects as reference. The evidence so far is discouraging: LLMs fail to reproduce human response biases ( Tjuatja et al., 2024 ) , and their responses are mainly dominated by answer-position and label effects ( Dominguez-Olmedo et al., 2024 ) . Therefore, evaluators should assess whether personas’ answering processes resemble humans closely enough for context effects to be detectable, a particularly useful trait for applications like message pre-testing.
blocks.zh: 由于人类调查的答复随着第2级的问题措辞、项目顺序和答复格式而变化,我们以人类测试带和记录的上下文效应作为参考,检验合成样本是否与人们一样对上下文和格式作出反应。 目前为止的证据令人沮丧:LLMs未能复制人类反应偏差(Tjuatja等人,2024年),他们的反应主要以答案位置和标签效应为主(Dominguez-Olmedo等人,2024年)。 因此,评估人员应评估个人的回答过程是否与人类相似,足以探测到环境效应,这对于信息预测试等应用特别有用。

blocks.en: Most substantive uses of survey data concern how variables relate to one another, a characteristic that researchers cannot establish by matching question-marginals alone. Thus, level 3 assesses structural fidelity by testing whether the relationships between variables in a synthetic sample correspond to those in human data (i.e. correlations, regression coefficients, factor solutions, and the sign and ordering of predictors).
blocks.zh: 调查数据的大多数实质性用途涉及变量如何相互关联,而仅靠问题-边际的匹配,研究人员无法确定这一特征。 因此,第三级通过测试合成样本中变量之间的关系是否与人类数据中的关系(即相关性,回归系数,因子解决方案,以及预测器的标志和顺序)来评估结构的忠实性.

blocks.en: To our knowledge, evidence at this level is thin. Barrie and Cerina ( 2026 ) show that synthetic personas distort the covariance structure of belief systems even when univariate distributions look acceptable, so a factor structure or regression estimated on synthetic data does not transfer to humans. Meanwhile, Choi and colleagues ( 2026 ) find that simulated respondents inflate the correlation between belief and intention to share misinformation, and their regression weights favour attitudinal predictors while discounting the network characteristics that carry most of the association in human data. Associations can also be reproduced for the wrong reasons, for example, from stereotypes in third-party descriptions of a group ( Cheng et al., 2023 ; Bisbee et al., 2024 ) . Therefore, evaluators should treat a structure cleaner than human data as a failure rather than a success.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,这一级的证据是很少的。 Barrie和Cerina(2026年)表明,合成人即使单向分布看起来可以接受,也会扭曲信仰体系的共变结构,因此在合成数据上估计的一个因子结构或回归不会转移给人类. 与此同时,Choi和同事(2026年)发现,模拟的受访者加深了信仰与分享错误信息的意图之间的关联,他们的回归权重偏向于态度预测者,而忽略了人类数据中包含大多数关联的网络特征. 社团也可以出于错误的理由复制,例如,从第三方对一个团体的描述中的定型观念(Cheng等人,2023年;Bisbee等人,2024年)。 因此,评价人员应将结构清洁剂而非人类数据视为失败而非成功。

blocks.en: 2.3 Experimental correspondence
blocks.zh: 2.3 实验通信

blocks.en: Decision makers are often interested in modelling how an intervention will change some population. Accordingly, experimental correspondence (E) measures whether a manipulation affects a synthetic sample as it would with real respondents. Effects can be read at various target outcomes: for example, as a shift in stated support or uptake, comparisons that matter for policy design and for pre-testing experiments. Ashokkumar and colleagues ( 2026 ) validate LLM predictions against a large set of social science experiments, including meta-studies, and find strong correlations with human treatment effects but also a systematic overestimation of effect sizes. Likewise, researchers have recovered several classic experimental findings in simulation ( Aher et al., 2022 ; Horton et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 决策者往往对制定干预如何改变某些人口的模式感兴趣。 因此,实验性通信(E)衡量操纵是否对合成样品产生影响,如同对真正的被调查者一样。 可以在各种目标结果中看到效果:例如,作为声明的支持或吸收的转变,比较对于政策设计和试验前实验都很重要。 Ashokkumar和同事(2026年)验证了包括元研究在内的一系列大型社会科学实验的LLM预测,并发现与人类治疗效果的强烈关联性,但也系统地高估了效果大小. 同样,研究人员在模拟中恢复了一些经典的实验发现(Aher等人,2022年;Horton等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Behavioural research settles for between-person comparison because the same person cannot be run through treatment and control without carry-over or order effects ( Holland, 1986 ) ; randomisation makes groups comparable in expectation instead ( Rubin, 1974 ) , and individual treatment effects are not identified, so heterogeneity must be inferred from comparisons between subjects. A synthetic respondent removes this constraint. Once a persona specification exists, it can be duplicated and each copy assigned to a different condition—a within-persona counterfactual design ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . Holding the persona specification fixed allows repeated draws to estimate a condition contrast for each profile. These contrasts can reveal heterogeneity within the simulation, while their correspondence to human effects requires separate validation.
blocks.zh: 行为研究解决了人与人之间的比较问题,因为同一人无法在没有结转或订单效应的情况下通过治疗和控制运行(荷兰,1986年);随机化使得组别在预期中具有可比性(鲁宾,1974年),个人的处理效果没有被识别出来,所以必须从主体之间的比较中推断出异性. 合成答复者消除了这种限制。 一旦一个人的规格存在,就可以复制,并且每份被分配到不同的条件——一个人内反事实设计(Lin等人,2026年). 持有固定的人物规格允许重复绘图来估计每个剖面的条件对比. 这些对比可以揭示模拟内部的异质性,而它们与人类效应的对应需要单独验证.

blocks.en: Four problems complicate the interpretation and validation of these counterfactual contrasts. First, changing a prompt to implement a treatment can change the model’s inference about the respondent, not only the intended manipulation ( Gui and Toubia, 2023 ) ; Lin and colleagues ( 2026 ) call this user drift, since the implicit population then differs between conditions and the contrast is confounded. Second, model output is stochastic, so two copies of the same persona in the same condition will not answer identically, and the same-condition null distribution is therefore a precondition for interpreting any contrast. Third, the individual-level interpretation follows from the profile logic of Section 1.1 : a within-persona contrast estimates the effect for a profile (i.e., a conditional effect given the specification) which corresponds in human data to the average effect among people matching that profile. Even for consented person-level personas, the contrast remains a model-based estimate of an individual effect, since both potential outcomes cannot be observed for the same person under the same conditions. Fourth, published human estimates are also noisy and subject to publication bias, meaning agreement with meta-analytic estimates is the only strong validation where such benchmarks exist ( Camerer et al., 2018 ) . Consequently, the gold standard remains unclear, and evaluators should limit claims to rough magnitudes of treatment effects, for example, to prioritise intervention arms in an experimental design or to screen out interventions.
blocks.zh: 四个问题使这些反事实对比的解释和验证复杂化. 首先,改变一个实施治疗的迅速性可以改变模型对被申请人的推论,而不只是有意的操纵(Gui and Toubia, 2023);Lin和同事(2026)称这个用户漂移,因为隐含的人群随后因条件而异,反之则令人困惑. 第二,模型输出具有斯图克性,因此在相同条件下的同一个人a的两份拷贝不会相同回答,因此相同条件的无效分发是解释任何对比的先决条件. 第三,个人层面的解释遵循了第1.1节的剖面逻辑:一个人内对比估计了一个剖面的效果(即给定规格的有条件效果),这在人类数据中与符合该剖面的人的平均效果相对应. 即使对同意的人级个人来说,这种对比仍然是对个人影响的模型估计,因为在同一条件下,不能观察到同一人的两个潜在结果。 第四,公布的人类估计也非常吵闹,并受到出版偏见的影响,这意味着与元分析估计的一致是存在这种基准的唯一强有力的验证(Camerer等人,2018年)。 因此,金本位仍不明确,评估人员应把索赔限于处理效果的粗略程度,例如在实验设计中将干预武器放在优先地位,或排除干预。

blocks.en: Developing a validation procedure is also difficult, as there is no human research equivalent. A starting point could be to compare within-persona counterfactual effects with between-subject effects estimated on human samples matched to the same persona definitions, and to treat systematic divergence as the object of study. Here, two quantities ought to be matched: the average treatment effect in the human sample (viz. an E check) and the ordering of subgroup effects across strata, testing heterogeneity.
blocks.zh: 制定验证程序也很困难,因为没有人类研究的同等标准。 一个起点可以是比较人体内的反事实效应和与同一人定义相对应的人类样本的估计主体间效应,并将系统性差异作为研究对象。 在此,应当匹配两种数量:人类样本中的平均处理效果(viz. a E check)和分层效应排序,测试异性。

blocks.en: 2.4 What each use requires
blocks.zh: 2.4 (中文(简体) ). 每次使用都需要什么

blocks.en: As detailed at the start of Section 2 , our introduction’s use cases map onto our levels of correspondence. Exploratory use (hypothesis generation, piloting, checking instruments) requires that L0 to L2 fall within the human bands for each relevant subgroup, and researchers disclose any subgroup for which no comparison is possible. Substitutive use, in which a synthetic sample stands in for a human one in a comparison between conditions or groups, additionally requires L3 invariance across the compared subgroups, demonstrated E correspondence on benchmark manipulations, and a human anchor for calibration or rectification ( Krsteski et al., 2025 ) . Predictive use, and any use that allocates resources across groups, requires C for the relevant subgroups at or above declared baselines. Finally, a subgroup that fails invariance or lacks behavioural evidence cannot inherit conclusions drawn from the aggregate.
blocks.zh: 正如第2节开始时所详述的,我们的导言将使用案例映射到我们的通信水平上。 探索性用途(假说生成,试飞,检查仪器)要求L0到L2属于每个相关分组的人类波段,研究人员披露任何无法进行比较的分组. 替代使用,在比较条件或群体时,合成样品代表人类使用,另外要求比较分组的L3偏差,证明E在基准操纵上的对应,以及用于校准或校正的人类锚(Krsteski等人,2025年)。 预测性使用,以及将资源分配给各组别的任何使用,都要求有关分组在申报的基线或以上使用C。 最后,一个分组如果未能变化或缺乏行为证据,就不能继承从总数中得出的结论。

blocks.en: 3 Target group validity
blocks.zh: 3 目标群体有效性

blocks.en: 3.1 Aggregate accuracy hides subgroup failure
blocks.zh: 3.1 聚合精度隐藏分组失败

blocks.en: Having set out the behavioural criterion and diagnostic levels that researchers should use for their validity claims, we turn to subgroup specification as a validity requirement. In this setting, researchers must first appreciate how an accuracy figure computed over full samples acts as a weighted average dominated by its largest groups. Indeed, a synthetic sample can reproduce a population mean while still being wrong for every subgroup within it, so long as the errors offset. Disaggregated evaluation in machine learning repeatedly documents this pattern, with high error rates in specific intersectional subgroups ( Obermeyer et al., 2019 ; Buolamwini and Gebru, 2018 ) . As a consequence, disaggregated evaluation has become a reporting standard ( Mitchell et al., 2019 ) , with calibration requirements within subgroups, and training objectives targeting worst-group performance ( Sagawa et al., 2019 ) . For language models specifically, Gallegos and colleagues ( 2024 ) review available fairness metrics and evaluation datasets and note that most address model output for demographic groups in isolation, which is close to the subgroup logic we propose here.
blocks.zh: 在规定了研究人员应该用于其有效性主张的行为标准和诊断水平之后,我们转而将分组规格作为有效性要求。 在此情况下,研究人员必须首先了解在完整样本上计算出的准确数字如何作为最大组群占主导地位的加权平均数。 实际上,只要错误被抵消,合成样本可以复制一个人口,而对于其中的每一个分组来说,仍然是错误的。 机器学习中的分类评价反复记录这种模式,特定交叉分组的误差率很高(Obermeyer等人,2019年;Buolamwini和Gebru,2018年). 因此,分类评价已成为一种报告标准(Mitchell等人,2019年),各分组内部有校准要求,培训目标是针对最差群体的业绩(Sagawa等人,2019年)。 特别是语言模型,Gallegos和同事(2024年)审查现有的公平度量衡和评价数据集,并指出,大多数针对与世隔绝的人口群体的模型输出,这接近于我们在此提议的分组逻辑。

blocks.en: Three mechanisms produce subgroup failure in synthetic samples. First, models can learn the population-level statistics directly, for example from published polling in their training data, without learning the group-level structure that underpin them. Second, model performance tracks training-data coverage, and coverage tends to be low for very specific subpopulations (e.g., older people, people with low incomes, speakers of less-represented languages, and people with limited digital participation). Third, Kumar and colleagues ( 2025 ) show that models trained to answer questions helpfully cannot easily be instructed to mimic incapacity. This matters for consequential behaviour because non-uptake often stems from not knowing an option exists, not understanding it, or not managing the process. Hence, a persona set that cannot represent these states will over-predict uptake in the groups where they are most common.
blocks.zh: 三种机理在合成样品中产生子故障. 首先,模型可以直接学习人口一级的统计,例如从其培训数据中公布的民意测验中学习,而不学习支撑它们的群体一级结构. 第二,示范性业绩跟踪培训数据覆盖面,对于非常具体的亚人群(如老年人、低收入者、说较少语言的人和数字参与有限的人)而言,覆盖面往往较低。 第三,Kumar和同事(2025年)表明,接受过回答问题培训的模型不容易被指示模仿丧失能力。 这对间接行为很重要,因为不承担往往源于不知道存在、不理解或不管理一个过程。 因此,无法代表这些状态的人集将过度预测其最常见群体中的吸收率。

blocks.en: Given these failure cases, we argue that researchers must report validity claims about synthetic samples at a subgroup level, following a fixed procedure. Subgroups should be defined before validation and based on the decision context rather than the data. For example, for an energy tariff, relevant partitions could be income band, tenure, dwelling type, and household composition, fixed before inspecting any synthetic data. If sample sizes allow, researchers should also report cells formed by crossing the two or three most decision-relevant attributes, since these intersections are where aggregate-level checks fail ( Kearns et al., 2017 ) . Finally, we encourage researchers to report worst-group performance alongside the average, since this describes the group most likely to be harmed by an error.
blocks.zh: 鉴于这些故障情况,我们主张,研究人员必须遵循固定程序,在一个分组一级报告关于合成样品的有效性主张。 在审定之前,应根据决定的背景而不是数据确定分组。 例如,就能源关税而言,相关的分配可以是收入范围、保有权、住房类型和家庭组成,在检查任何综合数据之前加以固定。 如果样本大小允许,研究人员还应报告通过跨越两个或三个最与决策相关的属性形成的细胞,因为这些交叉点是聚合级检查失败的地方(Kearns等人,2017年). 最后,我们鼓励研究人员报告最差组别的业绩和平均数,因为这描述了最可能因错误而受到伤害的组别。

blocks.en: Our argument links directly to the validity levels outlined in Section 2 . C reflects calibration in each stratum, as set out in Section 2.1 . Meanwhile, at L0 we have a subgroup-specific point estimate, and at L1 we have a subgroup-specific distributional distance, which is where flattening becomes visible, as a model might reproduce the mean of a minority group while removing disagreement within it. At L3 researchers should capture measurement invariance across the strata being compared. Finally, under E, researchers should endeavour to measure subgroup-specific treatment effects (e.g., heterogeneous policy impacts).
blocks.zh: 我们的论点与第2节概述的有效性水平直接相关。 如第2.1节所述,C反映每个层的校准。 与此同时,在L0时,我们有一个分组特定的点估计,在L1时,我们有一个分组特定的分布距离,这就是平坦的明显之处,因为一个模型可能会复制一个少数群体的平均值,同时消除其中的分歧。 在L3中,研究人员应掌握不同阶层的测量变化。 最后,在E项下,研究人员应努力衡量具体分组的处理效果(例如,不同的政策影响)。

blocks.en: While making each claim, researchers must also state the precision of the human benchmark. Subgroup validity is bounded by the size of the human comparison sample, and a subgroup with thirty human respondents cannot support a strong validity claim in either direction. Thus, where human data are scarce, researchers can better spend their time manually rectifying synthetic estimates rather than fine-tuning the model. For instance, Krsteski and colleagues ( 2025 ) find that synthesis alone leaves 24 to 86% bias in population estimates, while rectification with a small human sample brings this below 5%. Consequently, although generated responses remain uncorrected, which matters wherever they are used for follow-up questions, a validity guarantee applies to the corrected subgroup estimates.
blocks.zh: 在提出每项要求时,研究人员还必须说明人类基准的精确性。 分组有效性取决于人类比较样本的大小,由30名人类答复者组成的分组不能支持任何方向的强烈有效性主张。 因此,在人类数据稀缺的地方,研究人员可以更好地花时间手动纠正合成估计,而不是对模型进行微调. 例如,Krsteski和同事(2025年)发现,仅合成就给人口估计留下了24%至86%的偏差,而用一个小的人类样本进行校正则使这一偏差低于5%。 因此,虽然产生的答复仍未更正,无论它们用于什么后续问题都很重要,但有效性保障适用于经更正的分组估计数。

blocks.en: 3.2 Justice dimensions as measurable quantities
blocks.zh: 3.2 司法层面作为可衡量的数量

blocks.en: To solidify our argument about the importance of subgroup specification in validity claims, we engage with justice frameworks from the literature on machine learning and the energy transition. In the former, frameworks for assessing algorithmic systems’ social impacts are numerous, and they converge on principles such as fairness, transparency, and accountability ( Fjeld et al., 2020 ; Floridi et al., 2018 ; Jobin et al., 2019 ; Buckland, 2025 ) . However, several reviews criticise them for stopping at the level of principle and rarely specifying measurement or violation rules ( Hagendorff, 2020 ; Mittelstadt, 2019 ; Morley et al., 2020 ) . More recent taxonomies of sociotechnical harm and of generative AI’s social impact are more concrete ( Shelby et al., 2023 ; Solaiman et al., 2024 ; Weidinger et al., 2022 ) , with impact assessment frameworks that specify a process ( Metcalf et al., 2021 ) and require indicators per affected group against an explicit counterfactual ( Bringmann et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了巩固我们关于分组说明有效性主张的重要性的论点,我们利用关于机器学习和能源过渡的文献中的司法框架。 在前者中,评估算法系统社会影响的框架很多,它们都集中在公平、透明度和问责制等原则上(Fjeld等人,2020年;Floridi等人,2018年;Jobin等人,2019年;Buckland,2025年)。 然而,多篇评论批评他们停留在原则层面,很少具体指明衡量或违反规则(Hagendorff,2020年;Mittelstadt,2019年;Morley等人,2020年). 较近期的社会技术伤害分类和遗传性AI的社会影响分类更为具体(Shelby等人,2023年;Solaiman等人,2024年;Weidinger等人,2022年),其影响评估框架规定了一个过程(Metcalf等人,2021年),要求每个受影响群体对照明确的反事实制定指标(Bringmann等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: However, rather than expand this work, we instead employ a justice framework originally developed for the energy transition whose three dimensions map directly onto the quantities defined in our evaluation framework. These three dimensions include (1) distributional justice concerns – who bears costs and who receives benefits; (2) procedural justice – who participates in decisions and how; and (3) recognition justice – whose situation is acknowledged rather than overlooked ( Jenkins et al., 2016 ; Sovacool and Dworkin, 2015 ) . Under our definitions, the distributional dimension corresponds to the distribution of prediction error across pre-specified subgroups, since a synthetic sample that is more accurate for some groups than others will encourage decisions better tailored to easily-predicted groups. Likewise, the procedural dimension corresponds to researchers’ documentation of the process that produced the synthetic sample; namely, model identity and version, prompt text, sampling temperature, number of draws per persona, the construction of the persona set, and the human benchmark. Without this documentation, external parties cannot reproduce or contest a claim, which becomes a problem when prompt sensitivity is large enough to change conclusions ( Dominguez-Olmedo et al., 2024 ; Röttger et al., 2024 ) . Finally, the recognition dimension corresponds to preserved within-group variance, as removing dispersion within subgroups (L1) can be classified as representational harm ( Bender et al., 2021 ) . Ultimately, these indicators operationalise selected aspects of justice for validation, though they do not establish that a deployment is necessarily fair.
blocks.zh: 然而,我们没有扩大这项工作,而是采用了最初为能源过渡而制订的公正框架,其三个层面直接描绘在我们评价框架中确定的数量。 这三个方面包括:(1) 分配司法问题 — — 谁承担成本,谁获得福利;(2) 程序司法 — — 谁参与决定和如何参与;(3) 承认司法 — — 其状况被承认而不是被忽视(Jenkins等人,2016年;Sovacool and Dworkin,2015年)。 根据我们的定义,分布维度与预先指定的分组的预测误差分布相对应,因为对某些群体比其他群体更准确的合成样本将鼓励做出更适合容易预测的群体的决定。 同样,程序层面也符合研究人员对合成样品生成过程的文献记录;即模型身份和版本、即时文本、取样温度、人均图纸数量、人文集的结构以及人类基准。 没有这些文件,外部当事方就不能复制或质疑一项主张,当迅速敏感度足以改变结论时,就成为一个问题(Dominguez-Olmedo等人,2024年;Röttger等人,2024年)。 最后,识别维度对应的是保留在群体内的差异,因为消除分组内的分散(L1)可归类为代表损害(Bender等人,2021年)。 归根结底,这些指标将司法的某些方面用于验证,尽管它们并不确定部署必然是公平的。

blocks.en: 4 Application: Charging behaviour in the energy transition
blocks.zh: 4 应用程序: 能源过渡中的充电行为

blocks.en: The framework applies to any consequential decision. We illustrate it with a case from electric vehicle charging, as the distributional issues are explicit and it is a domain in which data about the relevant behavioural outcome (charging patterns) is accessible. Consider an electricity supplier that wants to evaluate a time-of-use tariff intended to shift electric vehicle charging into hours of high renewable generation. The consequential behaviour is the charging start time chosen, observable from meter data. The decision costs the household convenience and involves a financial trade-off. The policy question is whether the tariff shifts charging, by how much, and for which household types. A synthetic evaluation of this design would report, at C, whether the persona set predicts the observed charging start times of each household type at or above its base rate; at L0, whether it reproduces the baseline share of households charging in the target window; at L1, whether it reproduces the spread of start times, which determines how much shifting is available at all; at L3, whether the association between household characteristics and baseline timing matches the observed one; and under E, whether direction and magnitude of the tariff effect match the human estimate, read against meter data and not against stated willingness to shift.
blocks.zh: 该框架适用于任何相应的决定。 我们用一个电动车辆充电的案例来说明这一点,因为分配问题很明确,而且这是一个可以获得有关行为结果(充电模式)的数据的领域。 考虑一个电力供应商,想评估一项使用时间费,目的是将电动车辆的充电转换为高可再生发电时数。 相应的行为是从测量数据中可观察到的所选择的充电起始时间。 这一决定耗费了家庭的便利性,并涉及财务上的权衡。 政策问题是,关税是否按收费多少变动,以及哪些家庭类型变动。 对这一设计的综合评价将在C部分报告:人集是否以或高于其基准率预测每个家庭类型的观察到的充电起始时间;在L0部分,它是否复制了目标窗口中充电的家庭的基线份额;在L1部分,它是否复制了起始时间的分布,从而决定了有多少变化;在L3部分,家庭特征与基线时间之间的联系是否与观察到的时间相吻合;在E部分,关税效应的方向和幅度是否与人类估计相符,对照测量数据阅读,而不是对照表明的转移意愿阅读。

blocks.en: The subgroup requirement determines what such an evaluation is for. Households differ in whether they can shift charging in the first place. A household with off-street parking and a home charger faces a different decision from one that relies on public infrastructure, and a household in fuel poverty responds to a price signal differently from one for which the saving is negligible ( Walker and Day, 2012 ) . If a synthetic sample reproduces the aggregate shift, but overstates it for low-income and renting households, this is a distributional justice issue, as this would support a tariff that delivers its benefits to households with flexibility capital ( Powells and Fell, 2019 ) . It is advisable to define subgroups in ways that track behavioural constraints rather than simple demographics; for example, it might be in this case most insightful to understand access to a private charging point. This also limits the number of subgroups.
blocks.zh: 分组要求决定这种评价的目的。 家庭在一开始是否可以转移充电方面有所不同. 拥有街道外停车场和家用充电机的家庭面临着与依赖公共基础设施的家庭不同的决定,燃料贫乏的家庭对价格信号的反应不同于储蓄微不足道的价格信号(Walker and Day, 2012)。 如果一个合成样本再现了总体变化,但对低收入和租房家庭却夸大其词,这是一个分配公正问题,因为这将支持向具有灵活资本的家庭提供好处的关税(Powells and Fell, 2019)。 最好用跟踪行为限制而不是简单的人口统计来界定分组;例如,在这种情况下,了解进入私人收费点的机会可能是最有见地的。 这也限制了分组的数目。

blocks.en: Within-persona counterfactuals could be used here to examine how household personas respond under tariff and control conditions, providing an estimate of the shift for each household type. The estimate is a hypothesis about heterogeneity that the meter data can then test, which is an appropriate role for a pre-test. This example is meant to showcase what a report structured along the framework may involve, and that missing comparisons at particular levels and for particular subgroups will become visible in such a report.
blocks.zh: 这里可以使用个人内部的反事实来审查住户如何在关税和控制条件下作出反应,提供每类住户的转移估计数。 该估计是对异质性的假设,测量数据然后可以测试,这是预测试的适当作用. 这个例子旨在展示按框架编排的报告可能涉及的内容,而在特定级别和针对特定分组的缺失比较将在这种报告中显示出来。

blocks.en: 5 Reporting checklist
blocks.zh: 5 报告清单

blocks.en: The framework implies a short list of reporting items. We give them as a checklist because, in our reading of the literature, the main obstacle to comparing validation studies is inconsistency in what is reported rather than disagreement about standards. Studies that use synthetic samples to make claims about human behaviour should report the items given in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 该框架意味着报告项目的简短清单。 我们把它们当作一个核对表,因为在阅读文献时,比较验证研究的主要障碍是报告内容不一致,而不是对标准有分歧。 利用合成样品对人的行为提出主张的研究,应当报告表2所列项目。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: The framework comes with various limitations for which, currently, few or no solutions exist. First, contamination of training data is difficult to separately assess, i.e., a model might reproduce the result of a classic experiment because the paper is in its training data, which yields a correct prediction without any evidence about the underlying process ( Messeri and Crockett, 2024 ) —held-out experiments or using models whose training data pre-dates the event are likely the only mitigations. Second, subgroup analyses are bounded by the availability of human benchmark data at the subgroup level. Much of the attraction of synthetic samples is that they promise access to groups for which human data are scarce, and some of the interest stems from settings where human research data do not exist at all. The concept of algorithmic humility has here been proposed as a first rule for such deployments: a system should recognise when it operates at the edges of its training data or outside its competence, and should defer to human review in those cases ( Buckland, 2025 ) . Third, behavioural criteria have their own problems: public posting is performed behaviour, administrative records are shaped by the systems that produce them, and incentivised laboratory tasks are externally mandated and observed. Behaviour is the least bad criterion, but it is certainly not perfect. Fourth, model versions change, and a validity result is related to a specific model at a specific time. Providers update models without notice, so that validation evidence has a short shelf life. This argues for reporting model versions and access dates. Finally, and perhaps most crucially, the field still needs a comprehensive set of practical tests to establish which validity requirements synthetic populations meet and where their limitations constrain use.
blocks.zh: 该框架有各种局限性,目前几乎没有或根本没有解决办法。 首先,培训数据的污染难以单独评估,即一个模型可能复制经典实验的结果,因为论文在培训数据中,在没有任何证据证明基本过程的情况下得出正确的预测(Messeri和Crockett, 2024年),即进行保存的实验,或使用其培训数据在事件发生前可能是唯一缓解措施的模型。 第二,分组分析受分组一级人类基准数据提供情况的限制。 合成样本的吸引力大多在于它们承诺能够进入人类数据稀缺的群体,一些兴趣来源于人类研究数据根本不存在的环境. 这里提出了算法谦卑的概念,作为这种部署的第一规则:一个系统应承认它在训练数据边缘运行时或在其能力之外运行,并在这种情况下服从人类审查(Buckland,2025)。 第三,行为标准有自己的问题:公开发布是行为,行政记录由产生这些记录的系统决定,激励实验室的任务由外部授权和遵守。 行为是最差的标准,但肯定不完美。 第四,模型版本变化,一个有效性结果与特定时间的特定模型有关. 供应商不加通知地更新模型,这样验证证据的保存期限就很短. 这为报告模型版本和访问日期提供了理由。 最后,也许最关键的是,这个领域仍然需要一套全面的实际测试,以确定合成人口满足哪些有效性要求,以及其限制限制使用的情况。

blocks.en: One outlook follows from Section 1.2 . Theories of the attitude-behaviour relation, such as the attitude-behaviour-context model ( Guagnano et al., 1995 ) and Campbell’s paradigm ( Kaiser et al., 2010 ) , specify when self-report and behaviour converge, namely when the situational cost of acting is neither prohibitive nor negligible. Such theories could serve as a lens for judging when verbal correspondence is sufficient and where behavioural evidence is required, and they suggest that personas may have to be specified as persons in situations rather than as stable characters. A further step in this direction is to place personas as agents inside such a situation and read their behaviour off what they do there, an approach explored so far mostly for self-report-grounded agents ( Park et al., 2026 ) and for economic decision tasks ( Horton et al., 2023 ) , with actual conduct so far checked only against games rather than the field. Where agents interact, validation could also examine whether their patterns of coordination resemble those observed between people ( Chidichimo et al., 2026 ) . All the above are questions for later work.
blocks.zh: 该科的前景如下: 1.2 (中文(简体) ). 态度-行为关系的理论,如态度-行为-文字模型(Guagnano等人,1995年)和坎贝尔的范式(Kaiser等人,2010年),规定了自我报告和行为交汇的时间,即行为的情况成本既不是令人望而却步,也不是可以忽略的. 这种理论可以用作判断口头通信何时足够和何时需要行为证据的透镜,它们表明个人可能必须被确定为处于状况中的人而不是稳定的角色。 朝这个方向迈出的又一步是将人作为代理人置于这种情况下,并读出他们的行为,迄今为止,主要为自报代理人(Park等人,2026年)和经济决策任务(Horton等人,2023年)探索了一种方法,迄今为止,实际行为只针对游戏而不是现场。 在代理人互动的情况下,验证还可以检查其协调模式是否类似于人们之间观察到的模式(Chidichimo等人,2026年)。 以上均为以后工作的问题.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Synthetic samples generated by language models are being adopted fast. So far, much of the evidence tests whether models answer questionnaires in the same manner as people do, while trying to answer questions concerning consequential behavioural decisions. The gap between what people say and what they do is among the best-documented findings in behavioural science. Claims about consequential behaviour should therefore be validated against observed behaviour and reported separately within groups defined before the analysis.
blocks.zh: 语言模型生成的合成样品正在迅速被采用. 迄今为止,许多证据检验模型是否以与人们相同的方式回答调查问卷,同时试图回答有关随后行为决定的问题。 人所说的话与他们所做的事之间的差距是行为科学中最有记录的研究结果之一。 因此,关于间接行为的索赔应针对观察到的行为加以核实,并在分析之前界定的群体内单独报告。

blocks.en: The framework makes four testable predictions. First, structural fidelity (L3) and behavioural prediction (C) will be at most weakly related across persona sets and models. Second, where verbal fidelity carries behavioural information at all, it will be response-process fidelity (L2) rather than structure (L3) that carries it. Third, aggregate fidelity will overstate worst-subgroup fidelity, and the gap will grow as training-data coverage falls. Fourth, synthetic samples will reproduce the direction of human treatment effects more reliably than their size, and effect correspondence on stated outcomes will not transfer to behavioural outcomes without loss. If structure turned out to predict behaviour beyond process fidelity, the structural programme would be rehabilitated on exactly the criterion we advocate.
blocks.zh: 框架提出了四个可测试的预测. 首先,结构忠贞(L3)和行为预测(C)在人集和模型之间关系最薄弱。 第二,在口头忠贞带有行为信息的地方,是反应-过程忠贞(L2),而不是结构(L3)。 第三,总的忠诚度将超过最坏的亚群体忠诚度,随着培训数据覆盖面的缩小,差距将扩大。 第四,合成样品将比其大小更可靠地复制人类处理效果的方向,对所述结果产生对应作用不会转移到行为结果而无损失。 如果结构能够预测出超出过程忠实性的行为,则结构方案将完全按照我们所主张的标准得到恢复。

blocks.en: We have proposed a framework of predictive validity with a subgroup reporting requirement that follows established practice in machine learning evaluation, an operationalisation of three justice dimensions as quantities that can be read from a results table, and within-persona counterfactual design, which exploits a property of synthetic respondents without counterpart in human research and that itself requires validation. The framework makes claims comparable, and interpretations transparent. The field has spent three years asking how human-like synthetic respondents are on average. The better questions are what they can predict, and for whom.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个预测有效性框架,其中分组报告要求遵循机器学习评价的既定做法,将三个司法层面作为可从结果表中读到的数量加以操作,以及人内反事实设计,这种设计利用合成答卷人的财产,而没有对应的人类研究,其本身需要验证。 该框架使索赔具有可比性,解释透明。 现场花费了三年时间,询问类似人类的合成应答者平均情况如何. 更好的问题是,他们能对谁作出预测。
